OOS: getpid.description: OOS Forth: push the current process ID ( -- pid )

OOS: argc.description: OOS Forth: push the program argument count ( -- n )

OOS: arg.description: OOS Forth: get argument N as address and length ( n -- addr len )

OOS: argument as number.description: OOS Forth: read argument N and convert it to a number

OOS: s>number.description: OOS Forth: convert a string to a number ( addr len -- n )

OOS: ms.description: OOS Forth: sleep for a number of milliseconds ( ms -- )

OOS: load-file.description: OOS Forth: load a file into the data area ( fname-addr fname-len -- buf len )

OOS: save-file.description: OOS Forth: write a buffer to a file ( buf-addr buf-len fname-addr fname-len -- w )
